Our Intensive Community Services and Behavioral Support programs provide comprehensive, individualized care to help children and adolescents navigate emotional and behavioral challenges while promoting long-term growth and resilience. These services are designed to support youth in developing adaptive coping strategies, enhancing self-esteem, improving interpersonal and communication skills, and managing anger in healthy ways. All interventions are provided under the supervision of licensed practitioners and are guided by a structured, personalized plan of care tailored to each child’s unique needs.

Our approach emphasizes collaboration, working closely not only with the child but also with caregivers and family members when appropriate, ensuring a holistic support system that extends into the home and community. By combining evidence-based strategies with flexible, outcome-focused services, we empower children and adolescents to make meaningful progress, build confidence, and strengthen the skills needed to thrive in everyday life. These programs provide the guidance, structure, and support necessary to foster positive behavioral change, emotional well-being, and lasting success both at home and in the broader community.

Intensive In-Community Services are designed to support children and adolescents experiencing significant emotional or behavioral difficulties. Provided by a licensed clinician, these flexible services may involve caregivers and other family members to create a comprehensive support system. Following a tailored plan of care, Intensive In-Community Services address specific challenges, offering guidance and interventions that help the child achieve emotional regulation, positive behaviors, and meaningful progress in everyday life.

Behavioral Assistance Services provide concrete, outcome-oriented interventions designed to help children and adolescents develop essential coping and life skills. Under the supervision of a licensed practitioner, these services focus on enhancing self-esteem, interpersonal relationships, communication skills, and anger management. Delivered according to an individualized plan of care, Behavioral Assistance Services equip youth with practical strategies to navigate challenges, build confidence, and succeed both emotionally and socially.
